title: Access points software versions MR 33.1.1 changelog

announcements.post_subject: A new Beta MR Wireless firmware is now available

General Bug fixes: General stability, performance, and experience improvements
RRM channel and power changes occur every 30 minutes
Access points stop sending probe responses and 802.11 open authentications on all bands (radios)
Wi-Fi 7 APs don’t capture client wireless latency if at least one active SSID is using GCMP256 and/or SAE-EXT and 802.11be is off
HF ESL container offline in VCloud and does not recover due to stuck container after loss of connectivity
Wi-Fi 6 APs report "Config fetch error" alerts daily after firmware upgrade
Named VLAN does not assign the expected VLAN
Clients not redirected to CWA splash
AP fails to update Cisco ISE splash state override when client performs 11r roam
Intermittent webpage stalls on NAT mode SSID on Wi-Fi 7 APs
Campus Gateway clients intermittently lose network connectivity with excessive IPv6 link-local address churn
Model specific fixes - MR: MR57 configured for LACP causes MAC flap events after a failover by sending traffic out both of its uplinks
MR36H LAN ports intermittently fail to establish a physical Ethernet link when connected to certain Room Control Units (RCUs)

html:
Access points software versions MR 33.1.1 changelog

Info

  • Detailed release notes available at: https://documentation.meraki.com/Wireless/Product_Information/Compatibility_and_Firmware/MR_Firmware_Release_Notes

General Bug fixes

  • General stability, performance, and experience improvements

  • RRM channel and power changes occur every 30 minutes

  • Access points stop sending probe responses and 802.11 open authentications on all bands (radios)

  • Wi-Fi 7 APs don’t capture client wireless latency if at least one active SSID is using GCMP256 and/or SAE-EXT and 802.11be is off

  • HF ESL container offline in VCloud and does not recover due to stuck container after loss of connectivity

  • Wi-Fi 6 APs report "Config fetch error" alerts daily after firmware upgrade

  • Named VLAN does not assign the expected VLAN

  • Clients not redirected to CWA splash

  • AP fails to update Cisco ISE splash state override when client performs 11r roam

  • Intermittent webpage stalls on NAT mode SSID on Wi-Fi 7 APs

  • Campus Gateway clients intermittently lose network connectivity with excessive IPv6 link-local address churn

Model specific fixes - MR

  • MR57 configured for LACP causes MAC flap events after a failover by sending traffic out both of its uplinks

  • MR36H LAN ports intermittently fail to establish a physical Ethernet link when connected to certain Room Control Units (RCUs)
